_note: The catalogue's seed. Read by apps/web/src/lib/tool-catalogue-seed.ts and by the MCP server. NONE of it is on chain: a tool's atom derives every field from its normalised URL (packages/protocol/src/declare/tool-thing.ts), so `url` is the identity and `title` and `purpose` are this repo's, changeable without a write. User decision 2026-10-28: « le nom peut etre dans le front ».
_purposeSource: Each tool's `purpose` is the description the repository publishes about itself, read from the GitHub API on 2026-10-28. Never written by us: a sentence we invented about a tool we have not run is exactly the kind of claim rules/claims.md forbids. `null` where the repository publishes none — 7 of 52 — and a reader sees the URL instead.
_selection: data/measurements/catalogue-sources-2026-10-28.json. 21 MCP servers published by the vendor that controls the domain in the official MCP registry; 31 skill repos above 1,000,000 installs on skills.sh. Every URL returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-28. Mobbin was added on 2026-10-28 after the user pointed at it: it meets the same rule (com.mobbin, DNS-verified, repo HTTP 200) and was missed because the registry sweep truncated at com.s* and the vendor shortlist was hand-written. The shortlist is a bias, not a ranking — the registry holds 9,128+ namespaces and nothing in it measures standing.
